summary:

1. Resume upload cancel/clear button
2. Top-bar Home navigation button
3. Unified Model Comparison and Skill Gap analysis view
4. Skill proficiency levels (Beginner, Intermediate, Expert)
5. Interactive visual Career Learning Roadmap
6. Role-based 5-question Skill MCQ Practice Quiz with instant explanations
7. Interactive Build CV / Resume Builder with live preview and PDF export
